- Closes #<issue>

### Summary

<!-- What changed and why (1–3 bullets). -->

### Checklist

- [ ] Any **AI generated code** has been reviewed line-by-line by the human PR author, who stands by it.
- [ ] No **breaking changes** (or they are called out clearly and reflected in the changelog).
- [ ] **PR title** is fit for the [changelog](https://github.com/etiqa/pydantic-team/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
- [ ] Tests updated/added; `make ci-strict` passes locally (100% coverage on `pydantic_team`).
- [ ] Docs updated when public API or behaviour changes.
